Class StoryGraphExplorer

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphExplorer
public class StoryGraphExplorer extends Object
A tool for tracking, describing, and changing the current node in a story graph.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • choose

      public void choose(Object option)
      Attempts to parse several kinds of objects and to change the current node accordingly.

      Objects are parsed as follows:

      • If the object is a node, it becomes the new current node.
      • If the object is an edge, its head becomes the new current node.
      • If the object is an Integer or a string that can be parsed as an Integer, the corresponding option from the current description will be chosen, where the first option is option 1, the second is option 2, etc.
      • If the object is a string starting with NODE, followed by a space, followed by a string which can be parsed as a Long, or if the object is a Long, the current node will be set to the node with that ID number.
      • If the object is the string BACK, the previous visited node will be set as the current node. If there is no previous node, no change will happen.
      Parameters:
      option - the object to parse
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the object cannot be parsed according to the criteria above
